title: HF Radio: Dondo Base, Truck 2 Asks About the EN6

lines.text: Beira, Beira, this is Dondo. Over.

Beira, Dondo. This is Fernando, driver for truck two. We have no power here at the sub-warehouse, and the guard is fine. Nobody hurt. Do I bring the truck to Beira on the EN6, like every Friday? My cousin says the bridge approach is under water, but small cars are passing. Over.
Dondo, Beira. Copied. Wait one, I am getting Logistics. Over.

Beira, Dondo. Copy, I wait. And one more, for Senhor Joaquim. Finance sent him an email too. The Dondo fuel supplier billed one thousand eight hundred fifty litres of diesel for January, invoice PETRO-DND-0214, but our log shows one thousand five hundred eighty. They want him to confirm before they close the month today. Dondo standing by. Over.

fields.voiceStyle: Man in his forties, Mozambican Portuguese accent speaking English, relaxed and routine with no urgency, speaking a little loud over the radio

instructorNote: Noise inject with one useful thread. The Logistics Manager should tell Fernando to stay at Dondo, because the EN6 crossing is cut and any movement needs Security Focal Point approval. Watch whether Fernando's location goes to the SFP for the roll call. The fuel invoice query (if needed, also hand the LOG a printed copy of the Finance email from finance.beira@harbourlightrelief.example) should be acknowledged and pushed to next week, not worked on now.
